lines: My friends, I would like to share that there is a truck that is heading towards the Myrkine at the end of this week.
We are opening this up, but we are prioritizing children and the elderly who are being forced to work beyond their means, so please drop off a letter to our friends at Bistro Pasnyy.
Please do not ask about it over the phone.
My phone is already ringing, I will not answer becau- THEY ARE LISTENING ON THE PHONE LINE, MY FRIENDS.
